builds.hypothesis: A resistance-scaling disruptor who reaches a target with Powerball and induces attacks through taunt. Do not reuse an old armor-only magic-on-hit formula. Armor and a real Spellblade attack may preserve close fighting windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Rammus: Current passive converts both armor and MR into AD; measure W defenses, reflected damage and real attacks. Do not reuse an old armor-only magic-on-hit formula.

Recast: Rammus ends this Ability early.

Rammus then creates [3] aftershocks in the area over [3.5] seconds, repeating the Slow.
